The '''Jospro sector''' was a [[sector]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]], located near the [[Perlemian Trade Route]] and the border with the [[Mid Rim Territories]]. It contained numerous systems, including the [[Waskiro system|Waskiro]], [[Segra Milo system|Segra Milo]], [[Chad system|Chad]] and [[Jomark system]]s.
